# Assuming data['x'] contains the week numbers (categories) and data['y'] contains the production amounts
weeks = [item['label'] if isinstance(item, dict) else item for item in data['x']]

# Convert to numeric arrays for calculation
weeks_num = np.array([float(w) for w in weeks])
vals_num = np.array([float(v) for v in vals])

mask1 = weeks_num <= 13
mask2 = weeks_num >= 14
